verdict.rationale: Jules can be triggered via GitHub issues/labels or its API and can create PRs after being given error context (e.g., comm-15 shows it fixing after being fed an error message), and docs mention using the API to 'automate tasks like bug fixing' (jules-docs-9). However, there is no evidence of a native CI-failure trigger/integration that automatically diagnoses failed workflows without manual task assignment—this would require custom API wiring rather than built-in support.
